content.short: European business account, cards, invoicing and finance management.
content.description: Qonto is a leading European business banking platform, founded in France, that gives freelancers, startups, and SMEs an all-in-one account to manage company finances. From a single app it offers business accounts with local IBANs, physical and virtual cards, bookkeeping and invoicing tools, expense and supplier management, multi-user access with permissions, and integrations with accounting software. Operating across France, Germany, Italy, Spain, and other European markets, Qonto focuses on fast onboarding and features that reduce financial admin for busy teams. By combining a business account with cards, invoicing, and finance management, Qonto positions itself as the fast lane of business banking, competing with traditional banks and other European challengers for the region's growing base of small and medium companies.
